answer: Memory-hard puzzle gating resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to solve an Equihash-style challenge tied to its key and an epoch beacon before bidding. Peers verify the compact proof in milliseconds, acting like a falcon behind the velvet rope of task auctions. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of dedicated DRAM and compute energy per identity each epoch rather than cloning ivory masks for free. However, botnets or cloud clusters can still mint excess accounts.
